prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: ONE character's whole-head eight-direction sprite sheet for a pixel RPG.
Image1 is the approved front whole-head STYLE/SKULL-SIZE reference. Image2 is a LAYOUT-ONLY template, eight repeated front heads; REPLACE the repeated poses by eight TRUE yaw directions. Do NOT copy eight front views. If image3 is supplied, it is the approved identity reference for this particular head.
EXACT eight-cell layout: four columns, two rows, evenly spaced. Reading order row1: S front facing viewer; SW front-left 45deg; W left profile nose points LEFT; NW rear-left 135deg with back of hair and little/no visible face. Row2: N BACK OF HEAD no face/eyes; NE rear-right 135deg; E RIGHT PROFILE nose points RIGHT; SE front-right45deg. One identical person across all8, including hairstyle part/ear/horn locations. Same slight top-down game camera/pitch as image1, yaw only, no perspective zoom. Never duplicate a side or omit a rear view.
Logical sheet384x192, each cell96 square. Whole head only about50px wide, crown around local y24 and short bare neck ending near y74; neck anchor local(48,72). Each head is centered in its cell. Same physical skull/face size, jaw, eye spacing and bare-neck length in all8; profile naturally narrower but skull depth remains consistent. Plenty of transparent padding between heads and at canvas borders. Output WIDE2:1 sheet, no gridlines/text/labels.
Head includes face, hair, racial ears/horns and SHORT BARE NECK ONLY. NO clothes, neckline, collars, scarf, brooch, shoulders/body, armor, weapon, tail or background. Keep neck flesh with no shoulder silhouette. Hair may vary silhouette but stays compact around same skull; buns/ponytails end at nape, not shoulders. Head features fit cell; no giant ears/horns or inflated hair dome.
Style: crisp refined pixel art exactly like approved tiny reference. Readable small eye glyphs/eyelids/nose/mouth/chin, coherent 3-4 tone skin planes, small deliberate hair clusters with clear locks and selective highlights, thin selective material-colored outlines. Same pixel cluster density for all directions, no painterly smoothing, fuzzy gradient, blur, glow, thick black cartoon outline, random noisy speckles or giant anime portrait eyes. Keep frontal face proportions and slender adult head shape of reference, not a round baby/chibi face. True alpha transparency.
CHARACTER: human-f03. Adult woman, same skull/body-compatible head scale for both sexes. deep plum short nape ponytail with side-swept fringe. warm natural human skin. ordinary human ears, no horns or animal ears. warm amber eyes. Three hairstyles per sex must be visually distinct. Image1 supplies style/scale only; draw this new identity while keeping its face/skull proportions.
